map.每次呈现3支笔（2支相同、1支不同），要求受试者挑出气味不同者。共16组，每答对: Three pens are presented at a time, two alike and one different, and the subject must pick out the one that smells different. There are 16 sets and each correct answer scores 1 point, for a total of 0-16.

map.TDI 三分项含义？: What do the three TDI components mean?
map.T 阈值（能嗅出的最稀浓度）、D 辨别（两气味是否相同）、I 识别（命名气味），: T is the threshold, the most dilute concentration that can be smelled; D is discrimination, whether two odours are the same; and I is identification, naming the odour. Together they reflect both the threshold and the cognitive side of the olfactory pathway.
